profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at Blizzard Entertainment

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Contributing to the development of the next-generation API unification and Battle.net platform architecture, alongside platform standardization initiatives.  
- Driving key technical decisions and promoting collaboration across engineering teams to solve complex challenges in service performance, scalability, and reliability.  
- Mentoring junior and senior engineers, overseeing technical direction, and ensuring adherence to engineering best practices across projects.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer II
positions.description:
- Led research and evaluation of next-gen backend storage solutions, optimizing cloud-based storage testing frameworks for scalability, performance, and reliability.
- Managed the design and development of several Battle.net game service microservices to enhance scalability and maintainability.
- Proposed and implemented architectural refactors to simplify designs and improve scalability.  
- Proactively identified and resolved production issues during various game title launches, improving backend service stability.  
- Mentored junior engineers, sharing expertise and guiding their development.

positions.title: Senior software engineer I
positions.description:
- Designed and developed scalable Battle.net backend microservices for managing multi-title player sessions, licenses, billing functions, and IGR business models across all Blizzard and Activision games.  
- Built and optimized services for high availability and low latency in live production environments.  
- Conducted performance testing and optimizations, troubleshooting production issues to ensure consistent service performance.  
- Worked cross-functionally with teams to integrate new technologies and improve service architecture.  
- Contributed to monitoring and logging systems, ensuring real-time insights into system health.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed authentication, authorization, and account management services, handling request analysis, design, development, and successful launch for the MMORPG TERA.
- Built backend services on Ubuntu Linux using Python Twisted, MySQL for storage, and Django for management tools, utilizing Yahoo UI and JQuery for front-end development.
- Created a petition processing system to manage distributed reports, customer service complaints, and GM responses. This included ticket issuance, real-time communication, satisfaction tracking, and statistical processing via a web-based client.
- Developed a microtransaction item delivery system, handling requests and game purchases. This system included request analysis, design, development, and a successful launch, with a RESTful web service provided for external teams in North America and Europe.
- Provided support during the launch of TERA and addressed live issues across regions including Korea, Japan, North America, Europe, and Taiwan.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed a shared client library to support microtransactions and game item storage for internal game teams and front-end services, using C# and C++.  
- Built an Ajax-based web management tool and backend services to facilitate microtransactions and game item storage.  
- Provided launch and live support for several casual games and tools across multiple countries, including North America, Taiwan, Japan, Thailand, and the Philippines.  
- Created an integrated account transition system for the PlayNC portal.  
- Collaborated with ArenaNet (a subsidiary of NCSoft) to port a new authentication service into casual games.  
- Decoupled purchase and billing data in the legacy system and led the database migration to integrate a new system, transitioning from the 10+ year-old Lineage 2 database to a next-generation billing storage solution.
